# Scope: a booking tool for the baking classes

## The decision
Which booking tool takes bookings and deposits for the new baking classes.

## Requirements
- RQ-01 A class can be booked online with a deposit taken at booking (user-stated 2026-11-05)
- RQ-02 A reminder goes to each booked guest the day before (user-stated 2026-11-05)
- RQ-03 About six classes a week, twelve seats each, without a per-booking limit (user-stated 2026-11-05)

## Must-haves
- MH-01 A deposit is taken when a class is booked (RQ-01)
